ev.q: Estimated percentages were weighted, and confidence intervals were calculated using jackknife replicate weights.
16.2%–29.4% of HIV-positive persons were not screened for HIV during TB clinic visits
the percentage who reported that they had received HIV testing during a TB clinic visit ranged from 48.0% to 62.1%
These weighted percentages extrapolate to 47,383 HIV-positive persons in Malawi, 48,693 in Zambia, and 59,481 in Zimbabwe
The percentage of adults who reported having ever visited a TB clinic ranged from 4.7% to 9.7%.
viral load suppression rates were significantly higher among those who reported ever visiting a TB clinic
ART use was significantly higher (p<0.001 and p = 0.01, respectively)
nationally representative, cross-sectional, household-based, two-stage cluster sample surveys

methods_quotes.q: Estimated percentages were weighted, and confidence intervals were calculated using jackknife replicate weights.
Via chi-square tests, p values <0.05 were considered statistically significant.
Survey data were weighted to account for differential selection probabilities
The analysis was stratified by history of TB diagnosis
